(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY INTERLOCKS & SIL-3 QUENCH PROTECTION EVALUATION                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluates active-low hardware trips, localized quench resistive development, DC link     *)
(* overvoltage, cryogenic thermal excursion, and destructive mechanical hoop overstrain.   *)

dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;

(* Interlock 1.1: Active-low SIL-3 Emergency Stop Relay *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Hardwired Relay Open *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.2: System Enable Permissive Dropped *)
IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Master Enable Signal De-asserted *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.3: Catastrophic Superconducting Quench Detection *)
(* Evaluated via voltage tap bridge and inductive compensation residual *)
rSectorVoltMax_mV := MAX(rVoltageTap_Pancake1_mV, MAX(rVoltageTap_Pancake2_mV, MAX(rVoltageTap_Pancake3_mV, rVoltageTap_Pancake4_mV)));
IF (rSectorVoltMax_mV > rQuenchVoltageThreshold_mV) OR (rFilteredResidual_mV > rQuenchVoltageThreshold_mV) THEN
    tQuenchDebounceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15MS);
    IF tQuenchDebounceTimer.Q THEN
        bQuenchDetected := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Superconducting REBCO Quench Detected *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tQuenchDebounceTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#15MS);
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.4: Cryogenic Thermal Runaway (Exceeding Critical Safe Temperature) *)
IF (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K > rMaxCryoTempLimit_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K > rMaxCryoTempLimit_K) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: 2oo3 Coil Hot-Spot Thermal Runaway Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.5: Current Lead Thermal Degradation *)
IF (rCryoTemp_CurrentLeadLower_K > 35.00) OR (rCryoTemp_CurrentLeadUpper_K > 320.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Vapor-Cooled Current Lead Overheating *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.6: PCU Intermediate DC Bus Overvoltage *)
IF rDcBusVoltage_kV > rMaxDcBusVoltage_kV THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: DC Bus Severe Overvoltage Breakdown *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.7: PCU Intermediate DC Bus Undervoltage During Sync *)
IF (rDcBusVoltage_kV < rMinDcBusVoltage_kV) AND (iState >= 40) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: DC Bus Collapse Undervoltage Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.8: Superconducting Coil Overcurrent (Approaching Magnetic Fracture) *)
IF (rCoilCurrent_A_kA > rMaxCoilCurrent_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_B_kA > rMaxCoilCurrent_kA) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Coil Overcurrent Extreme Hazard Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.9: Severe Mechanical Hoop Overstrain (REBCO Ceramic Delamination Risk) *)
rMaxInnerStrain_ustrain := MAX(rFBG_Strain_PancakeInner_A_ustrain, MAX(rFBG_Strain_PancakeInner_B_ustrain, rFBG_Strain_PancakeInner_C_ustrain));
rMaxOuterStrain_ustrain := MAX(rFBG_Strain_PancakeOuter_A_ustrain, MAX(rFBG_Strain_PancakeOuter_B_ustrain, rFBG_Strain_PancakeOuter_C_ustrain));
rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain := MAX(rMaxInnerStrain_ustrain, MAX(rMaxOuterStrain_ustrain, rFBG_Strain_SupportRing_ustrain));
IF rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain > c_MaxSafeStrainLimit_ustrain THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: FBG Mechanical Hoop Overstrain Trip *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.10: Cryostat Vessel Extreme Overpressure *)
IF (rCryostatPressure_A_bar > 4.50) AND (rCryostatPressure_B_bar > 4.50) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Thermo-Siphon Cryostat Burst Hazard *)
END_IF;

(* Interlock 1.11: Cryocooler Cold Head Failure *)
IF (rCryoTemp_CondenserHead_K > 24.50) AND (iState >= 30) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Neon Condenser Re-liquefaction Loss *)
END_IF;

(* Master Safety Action: Transition directly to Quench / Fast Extraction State 100 *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#0000_0000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#0000_0000) THEN
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    iState := 100; (* State 100: Emergency Quench / Energy Extraction *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING & FAULT-TOLERANT DEGRADATION                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Executes mid-value median selection across critical instrument triplets:                 *)
(* Coil Current, Grid Frequency, Hot-Spot Temperature, and Cryostat Pressure.             *)
(* Gracefully degrades: 2oo3 -> 1oo2 -> 1oo1 fail-safe before latching a trip.              *)

dwDegradationWord := 16#0000_0000;

(* --- 2.1 HTS Coil Current 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_Curr_AB := ABS(rCoilCurrent_A_kA - rCoilCurrent_B_kA);
rDev_Curr_BC := ABS(rCoilCurrent_B_kA - rCoilCurrent_C_kA);
rDev_Curr_CA := ABS(rCoilCurrent_C_kA - rCoilCurrent_A_kA);

bCurr_A_Healthy := (rCoilCurrent_A_kA >= -0.10) AND (rCoilCurrent_A_kA <= 6.50);
bCurr_B_Healthy := (rCoilCurrent_B_kA >= -0.10) AND (rCoilCurrent_B_kA <= 6.50);
bCurr_C_Healthy := (rCoilCurrent_C_kA >= -0.10) AND (rCoilCurrent_C_kA <= 6.50);

IF bCurr_A_Healthy AND bCurr_B_Healthy AND bCurr_C_Healthy THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bCurr_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    (* Deterministic 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rCoilCurrent_A_kA >= rCoilCurrent_B_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_A_kA <= rCoilCurrent_C_kA)) OR
       ((rCoilCurrent_A_kA >= rCoilCurrent_C_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_A_kA <= rCoilCurrent_B_kA)) THEN
        rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_A_kA;
    ELSIF ((rCoilCurrent_B_kA >= rCoilCurrent_A_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_B_kA <= rCoilCurrent_C_kA)) OR
          ((rCoilCurrent_B_kA >= rCoilCurrent_C_kA) AND (rCoilCurrent_B_kA <= rCoilCurrent_A_kA)) THEN
        rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_B_kA;
    ELSE
        rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_C_kA;
    END_IF;
    (* Sensor Discrepancy Warning threshold: 0.15 kA *)
    IF (rDev_Curr_AB > 0.15) OR (rDev_Curr_BC > 0.15) OR (rDev_Curr_CA > 0.15) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Current sensor divergence warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bCurr_A_Healthy AND bCurr_B_Healthy THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := (rCoilCurrent_A_kA + rCoilCurrent_B_kA) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Coil current degraded to 1oo2 (C bad) *)
ELSIF bCurr_B_Healthy AND bCurr_C_Healthy THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := (rCoilCurrent_B_kA + rCoilCurrent_C_kA) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Coil current degraded to 1oo2 (A bad) *)
ELSIF bCurr_A_Healthy AND bCurr_C_Healthy THEN
    bCurr_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := (rCoilCurrent_A_kA + rCoilCurrent_C_kA) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Coil current degraded to 1oo2 (B bad) *)
ELSIF bCurr_A_Healthy THEN
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_A_kA;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Coil current 1oo1 single-channel mode *)
ELSIF bCurr_B_Healthy THEN
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_B_kA;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Coil current 1oo1 single-channel mode *)
ELSIF bCurr_C_Healthy THEN
    rCoilCurrentVoted_kA := rCoilCurrent_C_kA;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Coil current 1oo1 single-channel mode *)
ELSE
    bCurr_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* All three coil current sensors lost *)
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Grid Frequency 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_Freq_AB := ABS(rGridFreq_A_Hz - rGridFreq_B_Hz);
rDev_Freq_BC := ABS(rGridFreq_B_Hz - rGridFreq_C_Hz);
rDev_Freq_CA := ABS(rGridFreq_C_Hz - rGridFreq_A_Hz);

bFreq_A_Healthy := (rGridFreq_A_Hz >= 42.00) AND (rGridFreq_A_Hz <= 68.00);
bFreq_B_Healthy := (rGridFreq_B_Hz >= 42.00) AND (rGridFreq_B_Hz <= 68.00);
bFreq_C_Healthy := (rGridFreq_C_Hz >= 42.00) AND (rGridFreq_C_Hz <= 68.00);

IF bFreq_A_Healthy AND bFreq_B_Healthy AND bFreq_C_Healthy THEN
    bFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bFreq_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    IF ((rGridFreq_A_Hz >= rGridFreq_B_Hz) AND (rGridFreq_A_Hz <= rGridFreq_C_Hz)) OR
       ((rGridFreq_A_Hz >= rGridFreq_C_Hz) AND (rGridFreq_A_Hz <= rGridFreq_B_Hz)) THEN
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_A_Hz;
    ELSIF ((rGridFreq_B_Hz >= rGridFreq_A_Hz) AND (rGridFreq_B_Hz <= rGridFreq_C_Hz)) OR
          ((rGridFreq_B_Hz >= rGridFreq_C_Hz) AND (rGridFreq_B_Hz <= rGridFreq_A_Hz)) THEN
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_B_Hz;
    ELSE
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_C_Hz;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_Freq_AB > 0.08) OR (rDev_Freq_BC > 0.08) OR (rDev_Freq_CA > 0.08) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Frequency discrepancy warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bFreq_A_Healthy AND bFreq_B_Healthy THEN
    bFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := (rGridFreq_A_Hz + rGridFreq_B_Hz) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0100;
ELSIF bFreq_B_Healthy AND bFreq_C_Healthy THEN
    bFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := (rGridFreq_B_Hz + rGridFreq_C_Hz) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0200;
ELSIF bFreq_A_Healthy AND bFreq_C_Healthy THEN
    bFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := (rGridFreq_A_Hz + rGridFreq_C_Hz) * 0.50;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0400;
ELSIF bFreq_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_A_Hz;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0800;
ELSIF bFreq_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_B_Hz;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSIF bFreq_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFreq_C_Hz;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSE
    bFreq_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* All grid frequency meters lost *)

(* --- 2.3 Hot-Spot Cryogenic Temperature 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_Temp_AB := ABS(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K - rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K);
rDev_Temp_BC := ABS(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K - rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K);
rDev_Temp_CA := ABS(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K - rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K);

bTemp_A_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K >= 4.00) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K <= 100.0);
bTemp_B_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K >= 4.00) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K <= 100.0);
bTemp_C_Healthy := (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K >= 4.00) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K <= 100.0);

IF bTemp_A_Healthy AND bTemp_B_Healthy AND bTemp_C_Healthy THEN
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bTemp_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    IF ((rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K >= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K <= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K)) OR
       ((rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K >= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K <= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K)) THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K;
    ELSIF ((rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K >= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K <= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K)) OR
          ((rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K >= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K) AND (rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K <= rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K)) THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_Temp_AB > 1.20) OR (rDev_Temp_BC > 1.20) OR (rDev_Temp_CA > 1.20) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_4000; (* Temperature CERNOX deviation *)
    END_IF;

    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := MAX(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K, rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K); (* Conservative high-select *)
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_8000;
ELSIF bTemp_B_Healthy AND bTemp_C_Healthy THEN
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := MAX(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K, rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0001_0000;
ELSIF bTemp_A_Healthy AND bTemp_C_Healthy THEN
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := MAX(rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K, rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0002_0000;
ELSIF bTemp_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_A_K;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0004_0000;
ELSIF bTemp_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_B_K;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0008_0000;
ELSIF bTemp_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTemp_CoilHotSpot_C_K;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0010_0000;
ELSE
    bTemp_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0400; (* All CERNOX coil sensors failed *)
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 Cryostat Vapor Pressure 2oo3 Voting Bank --- *)
rDev_Press_AB := ABS(rCryostatPressure_A_bar - rCryostatPressure_B_bar);
rDev_Press_BC := ABS(rCryostatPressure_B_bar - rCryostatPressure_C_bar);
rDev_Press_CA := ABS(rCryostatPressure_C_bar - rCryostatPressure_A_bar);

bPress_A_Healthy := (rCryostatPressure_A_bar >= 0.50) AND (rCryostatPressure_A_bar <= 6.00);
bPress_B_Healthy := (rCryostatPressure_B_bar >= 0.50) AND (rCryostatPressure_B_bar <= 6.00);
bPress_C_Healthy := (rCryostatPressure_C_bar >= 0.50) AND (rCryostatPressure_C_bar <= 6.00);

IF bPress_A_Healthy AND bPress_B_Healthy AND bPress_C_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    bPress_Failed_Trip := FALSE;
    IF ((rCryostatPressure_A_bar >= rCryostatPressure_B_bar) AND (rCryostatPressure_A_bar <= rCryostatPressure_C_bar)) OR
       ((rCryostatPressure_A_bar >= rCryostatPressure_C_bar) AND (rCryostatPressure_A_bar <= rCryostatPressure_B_bar)) THEN
        rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_A_bar;
    ELSIF ((rCryostatPressure_B_bar >= rCryostatPressure_A_bar) AND (rCryostatPressure_B_bar <= rCryostatPressure_C_bar)) OR
          ((rCryostatPressure_B_bar >= rCryostatPressure_C_bar) AND (rCryostatPressure_B_bar <= rCryostatPressure_A_bar)) THEN
        rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_B_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_C_bar;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_Press_AB > 0.25) OR (rDev_Press_BC > 0.25) OR (rDev_Press_CA > 0.25) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0020_0000; (* Pressure transmitter mismatch *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPress_A_Healthy AND bPress_B_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := MAX(rCryostatPressure_A_bar, rCryostatPressure_B_bar);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0040_0000;
ELSIF bPress_B_Healthy AND bPress_C_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := MAX(rCryostatPressure_B_bar, rCryostatPressure_C_bar);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0080_0000;
ELSIF bPress_A_Healthy AND bPress_C_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := MAX(rCryostatPressure_A_bar, rCryostatPressure_C_bar);
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0100_0000;
ELSIF bPress_A_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_A_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0200_0000;
ELSIF bPress_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_B_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0400_0000;
ELSIF bPress_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedCryoPress_bar := rCryostatPressure_C_bar;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0800_0000;
ELSE
    bPress_Failed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0800; (* All cryostat pressure transmitters failed *)
    iState := 100;
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (dwDegradationWord <> 16#0000_0000);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 QUENCH DETECTION INDUCTIVE BRIDGE COMPENSATION & REBCO CRITICAL PHYSICS              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Eliminates mutual and self-inductive voltage L*(dI/dt) from terminal voltage taps to     *)
(* isolate microvolt-level normal zone resistive formation. Computes in-field Jc(B,T).     *)

(* 3.1 Time derivative of coil current *)
rCoilDIdt_kAs := (rCoilCurrentVoted_kA - rPrevCoilCurrent_kA) / c_ScanCycleTime_sec;
rPrevCoilCurrent_kA := rCoilCurrentVoted_kA;

(* 3.2 Synthetic inductive drop calculation: V_ind = L * dI/dt [kV] *)
rSyntheticInductiveVolt_kV := c_CoilSelfInductance_H * rCoilDIdt_kAs;

(* 3.3 Inductive bridge compensated residual voltage in millivolts *)
rBridgeResidual_mV := (rCoilTerminalVolt_kV - rSyntheticInductiveVolt_kV) * 1000.0;
rFilteredResidual_mV := (rFilteredResidual_mV * 0.850) + (rBridgeResidual_mV * 0.150);
rQuenchInductiveCompVolt_mV := rFilteredResidual_mV;

(* 3.4 In-field critical current calculation (Bean Model / Kim-Anderson approximation) *)
(* B_peak = k_field * I_coil; Ic(B, T) degrades monotonically with field and temp *)
rPeakMagneticField_T := c_FieldConstant_T_per_kA * rCoilCurrentVoted_kA;
IF rVotedCryoTemp_K < c_RebcoCriticalTemp_K THEN
    (* Empirical scaling: Ic(T,B) = Ic0 * (1 - T/Tc)^1.5 / (1 + B / 2.5) *)
    rRebcoTapeCriticalCurrent_A := c_RebcoSelfFieldIc0_A *
        ((c_RebcoCriticalTemp_K - rVotedCryoTemp_K) / (c_RebcoCriticalTemp_K - 20.0)) *
        (1.0 / (1.0 + (rPeakMagneticField_T * 0.40)));
ELSE
    rRebcoTapeCriticalCurrent_A := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.5 Operating Current Safety Margin relative to tape critical current *)
IF rRebcoTapeCriticalCurrent_A > 10.0 THEN
    rCriticalCurrentMargin_pct := (1.0 - ((rCoilCurrentVoted_kA * 1000.0) / (rRebcoTapeCriticalCurrent_A * 4.0))) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCriticalCurrentMargin_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.6 AC Loss Dissipation Estimation (Norris / Bean elliptical tape formula) *)
IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA > 0.05 THEN
    rEstimatedAcLosses_kW := 0.0005 * ABS(rCoilDIdt_kAs) * (rCoilCurrentVoted_kA * rCoilCurrentVoted_kA) * rPeakMagneticField_T;
ELSE
    rEstimatedAcLosses_kW := 0.002; (* Quiescent joint loss *)
END_IF;

(* 3.7 Real-time Stored Magnetic Energy: E = 0.5 * L * I^2 [MJ] *)
rStoredEnergy_MJ := 0.50 * c_CoilSelfInductance_H * (rCoilCurrentVoted_kA * rCoilCurrentVoted_kA);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 SUB-CYCLE (5ms) RoCoF & FOUR-QUADRANT P-Q FAST SYNCHRONOUS INJECTION                 *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Provides synthetic virtual inertia: P_inert = -2*H*(S_base/f_nom)*df/dt                   *)
(* Provides fast primary frequency response: P_droop = -Kp*(f - f_nom)                       *)
(* Provides dynamic voltage support: Q_droop = -Kq*(V - V_nom)                              *)

(* 4.1 High-speed discrete frequency derivative calculation (df/dt) *)
rFreqDerivativeRaw_Hzs := (rVotedGridFreq_Hz - rPrevGridFreq_Hz) / c_ScanCycleTime_sec;
rPrevGridFreq_Hz := rVotedGridFreq_Hz;

(* 4.2 Single-pole IIR anti-aliasing smoothing filter for RoCoF *)
rRoCoFFilterBuffer := (rRoCoFFilterBuffer * (1.0 - rRoCoFFilterCoeff)) + (rFreqDerivativeRaw_Hzs * rRoCoFFilterCoeff);
rGridRoCoF_Hzs := rRoCoFFilterBuffer;

rFreqDeviation_Hz := rVotedGridFreq_Hz - rNominalGridFreq_Hz;
rVotedGridVolt_kV := rGridVoltage_RMS_kV;
rVoltDeviation_kV := rVotedGridVolt_kV - rNominalGridVolt_kV;

(* 4.3 Synthetic Inertia Injection Demand [MW] *)
IF bSyntheticInertiaEnable AND (ABS(rGridRoCoF_Hzs) > 0.020) THEN
    (* P = -2 * H * S_base / f_nom * (df/dt) *)
    rInertiaPowerDemand_MW := -2.0 * rVirtualInertiaGain_H * (rApparentPowerLimit_MVA / rNominalGridFreq_Hz) * rGridRoCoF_Hzs;
ELSE
    rInertiaPowerDemand_MW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4.4 Primary Frequency Droop Power Demand [MW] *)
IF bPrimaryFreqCtrlEnable AND (ABS(rFreqDeviation_Hz) > 0.015) THEN
    (* Deadband of 15 mHz applied *)
    rDroopPowerDemand_MW := -rFrequencyDroopGain_Kp * rFreqDeviation_Hz;
ELSE
    rDroopPowerDemand_MW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4.5 Dynamic Reactive Power Voltage Support Demand [Mvar] *)
IF bVoltageSupportEnable AND (ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) > 0.150) THEN
    (* Deadband of 150 V RMS line applied *)
    rVoltageSupportDemand_Mvar := -rVoltageDroopGain_Kq * rVoltDeviation_kV;
ELSE
    rVoltageSupportDemand_Mvar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4.6 Four-Quadrant Apparent Power Envelope Limiter (Circular MVA Boundary) *)
rTotalActiveDemandRaw_MW := rInertiaPowerDemand_MW + rDroopPowerDemand_MW;

(* Clamp Reactive Power to MVA rating first if prioritized, or balance *)
rTotalReactiveDemandClamped_Mvar := LIMIT(-22.0, rVoltageSupportDemand_Mvar, 22.0);
rMaxPAllowed := SQRT(MAX(0.01, (rApparentPowerLimit_MVA * rApparentPowerLimit_MVA) - (rTotalReactiveDemandClamped_Mvar * rTotalReactiveDemandClamped_Mvar)));

(* Clamp Active Power within permissible inverter boundary & coil charge/discharge limits *)
IF rTotalActiveDemandRaw_MW >= 0.0 THEN
    (* Discharging SMES into grid *)
    rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW := MIN(rTotalActiveDemandRaw_MW, MIN(rMaxPAllowed, rMaxDischargePower_MW));
    (* Ensure sufficient energy stored to discharge *)
    IF rStoredEnergy_MJ < 2.50 THEN
        rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW := rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW * (rStoredEnergy_MJ / 2.50);
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Charging SMES from grid *)
    rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW := MAX(rTotalActiveDemandRaw_MW, MAX(-rMaxPAllowed, -rMaxChargePower_MW));
    (* Prevent overcharging coil beyond 50 MJ *)
    IF rStoredEnergy_MJ > 50.50 THEN
        rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

rActivePowerDemand_MW := rTotalActiveDemandClamped_MW;
rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar := rTotalReactiveDemandClamped_Mvar;

bFrequencySupportActive := (ABS(rActivePowerDemand_MW) > 0.10);
bVoltageSupportActive := (ABS(rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar) > 0.10);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 LORENTZ HOOP STRESS & OPTICAL FIBER BRAGG GRATING (FBG) EVALUATION                   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Translates FBG microstrain telemetry to hoop stress in Hastelloy C-276 substrate.        *)
(* Monitors strain rate of change d_epsilon/dt for mechanical slip / tape delamination.    *)

(* 5.1 Analytical Lorentz magnetic pressure: P_mag = B^2 / (2 * mu_0) [MPa] *)
(* mu_0 = 4*pi*1e-7 H/m. P_mag = (B^2 / (2 * 1.2566e-6)) * 1e-6 = B^2 / 2.5133 *)
rMagneticPressure_MPa := (rPeakMagneticField_T * rPeakMagneticField_T) / 2.513274;

(* 5.2 Hoop Stress in Hastelloy substrate: sigma = E * epsilon *)
(* E = 210 GPa = 210,000 MPa. epsilon in microstrain = strain * 1e-6 *)
rFBG_MeasuredStress_MPa := (c_HastelloyModulus_GPa * 1000.0) * (rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain * 0.000001);
rLorentzHoopStress_MPa := rFBG_MeasuredStress_MPa;

(* 5.3 Dynamic strain rate of change *)
rStrainRateOfChange_ustrains := (rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain - rPrevMaxStrain_ustrain) / c_ScanCycleTime_sec;
rPrevMaxStrain_ustrain := rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain;

(* Sudden micro-slip stick warning if strain rate exceeds 850 ustrain/s *)
bStrainRateWarning := (ABS(rStrainRateOfChange_ustrains) > 850.0);
bHoopStressWarning := (rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain > rMaxAllowableStrain_ustrain * 0.88);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 LIQUID NEON / HELIUM CLOSED THERMO-SIPHON CRYOGENIC GOVERNOR                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Regulates cryostat vapor dome pressure (nominal 2.10 bar) and natural circulation head.  *)
(* Modulates cryogenic neon bypass / re-condensation expansion throttle valve via PID.     *)

(* 6.1 Cryostat vapor dome pressure error *)
rCryoPressureError_bar := rVotedCryoPress_bar - rTargetCryoPressure_bar;

(* 6.2 Anti-windup PID regulator for thermo-siphon expansion valve *)
rCryoPressurePidIntegral := rCryoPressurePidIntegral + (rCryoPressureError_bar * c_ScanCycleTime_sec);
rCryoPressurePidIntegral := LIMIT(-20.0, rCryoPressurePidIntegral, 20.0);

rCryoPressurePidDerivative := (rCryoPressureError_bar - rPrevCryoPressureError_bar) / c_ScanCycleTime_sec;
rPrevCryoPressureError_bar := rCryoPressureError_bar;

rCryoValveRawDemand_pct := 35.0 + (rCryoPidKp * rCryoPressureError_bar) +
                           (rCryoPidKi * rCryoPressurePidIntegral) +
                           (rCryoPidKd * rCryoPressurePidDerivative);

rThermoSiphonValveDemand_pct := LIMIT(5.0, rCryoValveRawDemand_pct, 100.0);

(* 6.3 Thermosiphon natural circulation driving head estimation *)
(* Delta_P = (rho_liq - rho_vap) * g * H_riser. H_riser = 2.45 m *)
rThermalHeadBuoyancy_bar := ((c_NeonLiquidDensity_kgm3 - c_NeonVaporDensity_kgm3) * 9.80665 * 2.45) * 0.00001;
rThermoSiphonMassFlow_kgs := SQRT(MAX(0.001, rThermalHeadBuoyancy_bar)) * 0.450;

bCryoStabilityWarning := (rVotedCryoTemp_K > 22.50) OR (rVotedCryoPress_bar > 2.80);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 8-STATE MULTIVARIABLE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)            *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Formulates an 8-state, 4-input state-space plant model. Solves real-time quadratic cost: *)
(* J = 0.5*(x-xref)^T * Q * (x-xref) + 0.5*u^T * R * u via projected gradient descent.      *)

IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* 7.1 Diagonal Initialization of Discrete Transition Matrix A (8x8) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 8 DO
            IF iRow = iCol THEN
                A_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.9985;
            ELSE
                A_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0000;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    (* Physical state couplings in A *)
    A_mat[1, 5] := -0.0025; (* Current decreases when active power is discharged *)
    A_mat[2, 1] :=  0.0012; (* Temperature rises with higher current joint dissipation *)
    A_mat[3, 5] := -0.0040; (* DC link drops during rapid power export *)
    A_mat[4, 5] :=  0.0065; (* Grid frequency rises with positive power injection *)
    A_mat[6, 2] :=  0.0080; (* Cryostat pressure rises as coil hot-spot heats neon *)
    A_mat[7, 1] :=  0.0045; (* Hoop strain increases quadratically with current *)

    (* 7.2 Input Coupling Matrix B (8x4) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            B_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0000;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    B_mat[1, 1] :=  0.0850; (* u[1] Chopper duty directly drives coil dI/dt *)
    B_mat[3, 1] :=  0.1200; (* u[1] Chopper duty charges DC bus *)
    B_mat[5, 2] :=  0.2500; (* u[2] Inverter active current drives active power *)
    B_mat[8, 3] :=  0.2500; (* u[3] Inverter reactive current drives reactive power *)
    B_mat[6, 4] := -0.0650; (* u[4] Cryo valve relieves vapor pressure *)

    (* 7.3 Diagonal State Penalty Q Weights *)
    Q_diag[1] := 1.50;  (* I_coil error weight *)
    Q_diag[2] := 8.00;  (* T_hot thermal error weight *)
    Q_diag[3] := 2.50;  (* V_dc bus error weight *)
    Q_diag[4] := 12.00; (* Delta_f grid frequency synchronization weight *)
    Q_diag[5] := 5.00;  (* P_grid tracking weight *)
    Q_diag[6] := 4.00;  (* P_cryo pressure regulation weight *)
    Q_diag[7] := 10.00; (* Hoop strain suppression weight *)
    Q_diag[8] := 3.50;  (* Q_grid reactive support weight *)

    (* 7.4 Diagonal Actuator Effort Penalty R Weights *)
    R_diag[1] := 0.80;  (* Chopper duty rate penalty *)
    R_diag[2] := 0.50;  (* Inverter active current rate penalty *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.50;  (* Inverter reactive current rate penalty *)
    R_diag[4] := 0.30;  (* Valve actuation penalty *)

    (* 7.5 Hessian Diagonal Approximation: H_jj = sum(B_ij^2 * Q_i) + R_j *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        H_diag[iCol] := rTempSum + R_diag[iCol];
        IF H_diag[iCol] < 0.001 THEN
            H_diag[iCol] := 0.001;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 7.6 Update State Vector from Telemetry *)
x_state[1] := rCoilCurrentVoted_kA;
x_state[2] := rVotedCryoTemp_K;
x_state[3] := rDcBusVoltage_kV;
x_state[4] := rFreqDeviation_Hz;
x_state[5] := rGridActivePower_MW;
x_state[6] := rVotedCryoPress_bar;
x_state[7] := rMaxVotedStrain_ustrain;
x_state[8] := rGridReactivePower_Mvar;

(* 7.7 Target Reference State Vector *)
x_ref[1] := c_NominalCoilCurrent_kA;
x_ref[2] := 20.00;
x_ref[3] := 3.300;
x_ref[4] := 0.000;
x_ref[5] := rActivePowerDemand_MW;
x_ref[6] := rTargetCryoPressure_bar;
x_ref[7] := 2400.0;
x_ref[8] := rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar;

(* Tracking Error Calculation *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
    x_err[iRow] := x_state[iRow] - x_ref[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* 7.8 Real-Time Optimization Execution *)
IF bMpcOptimizerEnable AND (iState = 50) THEN
    bMpcInOptimization := TRUE;
    (* Active-set gradient computation: grad_J = B^T * Q * x_err + R * u *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 8 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * x_err[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        grad_J[iCol] := rTempSum + (R_diag[iCol] * u_mpc[iCol]);
        (* Projected Newton-Raphson update: Delta_u = -grad_J / H_diag *)
        u_delta[iCol] := -(grad_J[iCol] / H_diag[iCol]) * rStepSize;
        u_mpc[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol] + u_delta[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    (* Constrain MPC inputs to physical bounds *)
    u_mpc[1] := LIMIT(-0.45, u_mpc[1], 0.45);   (* Chopper duty offset Delta_D *)
    u_mpc[2] := LIMIT(-4.50, u_mpc[2], 4.50);   (* Inverter d-current [kA] *)
    u_mpc[3] := LIMIT(-4.50, u_mpc[3], 4.50);   (* Inverter q-current [kA] *)
    u_mpc[4] := LIMIT(5.0,   u_mpc[4], 100.0);  (* Valve demand [%] *)
ELSE
    bMpcInOptimization := FALSE;
    u_mpc[1] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[2] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[3] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[4] := rThermoSiphonValveDemand_pct;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 BIDIRECTIONAL THYRISTOR CHOPPER & PCU MODULATION GOVERNOR                           *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Controls the H-bridge bidirectional chopper duty cycle and the PWM VSI d-q modulation.  *)
(* Duty cycle D = 0.50 maintains persistent current (V_L = 0).                              *)
(* D > 0.50 charges coil from DC link; D < 0.50 discharges coil into DC link.               *)

IF (iState = 50) OR (iState = 60) THEN
    (* 8.1 Active power demand conversion to coil voltage: P = -V_L * I_coil *)
    (* V_L = -P_active / I_coil. If P_active > 0 (discharge), V_L < 0. *)
    IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA > 0.10 THEN
        rChopperDemandedVoltage_kV := -(rActivePowerDemand_MW / rCoilCurrentVoted_kA);
    ELSE
        rChopperDemandedVoltage_kV := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    (* Chopper voltage relation: V_L = V_dc * (2*D - 1) => D = 0.5 + 0.5 * (V_L / V_dc) *)
    IF rDcBusVoltage_kV > 1.00 THEN
        rChopperDutyRaw := rNominalDutyBias + (0.50 * (rChopperDemandedVoltage_kV / rDcBusVoltage_kV)) + u_mpc[1];
    ELSE
        rChopperDutyRaw := 0.500;
    END_IF;
    rThyristorDutyCycle := LIMIT(0.050, rChopperDutyRaw, 0.950);

    (* 8.2 VSI Active & Reactive Modulation Indices (d-q frame) *)
    (* m_d governs active power export, m_q governs reactive power support *)
    rInverterModIndex_d := LIMIT(-rVsiModulationIndexMax, (rActivePowerDemand_MW / 25.0) + (u_mpc[2] * 0.10), rVsiModulationIndexMax);
    rInverterModIndex_q := LIMIT(-rVsiModulationIndexMax, (rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar / 25.0) + (u_mpc[3] * 0.10), rVsiModulationIndexMax);
    rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
ELSIF (iState = 40) THEN
    (* Persistent Mode: Freewheeling at D = 0.50, zero net power exchange *)
    rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.500;
    rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
    rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
    rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
ELSIF (iState = 90) THEN
    (* Controlled Fast Ramp Discharge *)
    rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.200; (* Strong discharge into DC bus *)
    rInverterModIndex_d := 0.850; (* Exporting all power to substation *)
    rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
    rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
ELSIF (iState = 100) THEN
    (* Emergency Quench / Pyro-Breaker Dump *)
    rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.000;
    rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
    rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
    rDumpResistorContactor := TRUE; (* Contactor engaged across dump resistor *)
ELSE
    rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.500;
    rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
    rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
    rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* 11-Stage Deterministic State Machine governing cooldown, pre-charge, persistent standby, *)
(* sub-cycle 4-quadrant grid sync, fault ride-through, and emergency quench extraction.     *)

CASE iState OF

        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bPersistentModeActive := FALSE;
        bFastDischargeActive := FALSE;
        bPyroBreakerFired := FALSE;
        rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;

        bSystemRunning := FALSE;

            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#30S);
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Thermo-Siphon Equilibrium *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#30S);
        END_IF;

        bSystemReady := FALSE;

            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF bGridSyncPermissive AND bQuenchDetectPermissive THEN

        IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA < (c_NominalCoilCurrent_kA - 0.050) THEN
            rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.550; (* Moderate charging duty *)
            rInverterModIndex_d := -0.350; (* Drawing power from grid to charge *)
        ELSE
            rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.500;
            rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
            iState := 40; (* Proceed to Standby Persistent Mode *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: STANDBY PERSISTENT FREELING MODE (50 MJ STORED) *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bPersistentModeActive := TRUE;
        bFastDischargeActive := FALSE;
        (* Ready to inject power instantly when frequency or voltage deviates *)
        IF (ABS(rFreqDeviation_Hz) > 0.025) OR (ABS(rGridRoCoF_Hzs) > 0.050) OR (ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) > 0.300) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Engage Sub-Cycle Fast Regulation *)
        ELSIF bFastDischargeCmd THEN
            iState := 90; (* Commenced Controlled Fast Discharge *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: ACTIVE SUB-CYCLE FREQUENCY REGULATION & 4-QUADRANT INERTIA *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bPersistentModeActive := FALSE;
        (* Severe transient detection: transfer to FRT state if frequency or voltage drops catastrophically *)
        IF (ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) > 3.50) OR (ABS(rGridRoCoF_Hzs) > 1.20) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transfer to Fault Ride-Through *)
        (* Return to persistent standby if grid returns to deadband for > 3.0 seconds *)
        ELSIF (ABS(rFreqDeviation_Hz) <= 0.012) AND (ABS(rGridRoCoF_Hzs) <= 0.015) AND (ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) <= 0.100) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#3S);
                iState := 40; (* Return to Persistent Standby *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#3S);
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: SEVERE GRID TRANSIENT / FAULT RIDE-THROUGH (FRT) *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        (* Maximize reactive current for grid voltage support up to 100% inverter rating *)
        rReactivePowerDemand_Mvar := -25.0;
        IF ABS(rVoltDeviation_kV) <= 0.80 THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1S);
                iState := 50; (* Return to Standard 4-Quadrant Regulation *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1S);
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: CONTROLLED RAMP-DOWN / POWER RETRIEVAL *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.350;
        rInverterModIndex_d := 0.500;
        IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA <= 0.10 THEN
            iState := 0; (* Returned to Cold Off *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: CRYOGENIC THERMAL RECOVERY & BOIL-OFF RELIQUEFACTION *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bPersistentModeActive := TRUE;
        rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.500;
        rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
        rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
        rThermoSiphonValveDemand_pct := 80.0;
        IF (rVotedCryoTemp_K <= 20.20) AND (rVotedCryoPress_bar <= 2.15) THEN

        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CONTROLLED FAST RAMP DISCHARGE (DE-ENERGIZATION) *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bFastDischargeActive := TRUE;
        rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.150; (* Extracting maximum energy safely *)
        rInverterModIndex_d := 0.900; (* Injecting to grid *)
        IF rCoilCurrentVoted_kA <= 0.080 THEN
            bFastDischargeActive := FALSE;
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: EMERGENCY QUENCH / FAST EXTRACTION & PYRO-BREAKER FIRING *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;
        bPyroBreakerFired := TRUE; (* Open mechanical/explosive pyro-breakers *)
        rDumpResistorContactor := TRUE; (* Close dump loop across 0.20 Ohm resistor *)
        rThyristorDutyCycle := 0.000; (* Inhibit all chopper thyristor gating *)
        rInverterModIndex_d := 0.000;
        rInverterModIndex_q := 0.000;
        rThermoSiphonValveDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Full cryostat vent to relieve boil-off *)
        IF bResetFaults AND (rCoilCurrentVoted_kA <= 0.020) AND (dwAlarmWord1 = 16#0000_0000) THEN
            bSystemTripped := FALSE;
            bQuenchDetected := FALSE;
            bPyroBreakerFired := FALSE;
            rDumpResistorContactor := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Return to Cold Uninitialized *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Fault Safe Trap *)
        iState := 100;
END_CASE;
